name: Sakae, Yokohama (KuniJiban)
description: 75 borehole logs from road surveys around Sakae-ku, Yokohama, Japan (Yokohama Circular South Route, Ken-O-Do and Yokohama-Shonan Road; MLIT Yokohama National Highway Office, 2001–2025). The units are an interpretation of the logged soil names, SPT N-values and elevations by the unit rules, not formations named in the logs: Alluvium is the organic soils, clay and silt with N < 5 and sand and gravel with N < 20 below the 25 m valley floors; the Kazusa Group starts at the first mudstone, cemented silt or layer with N ≥ 50 (the bearing stratum). Terrain: GSI 5 m DEM, fetched when the project opens. Left out: five rock-core logs (H29-17-1, H29-17-2, H29-18-1, H29-18-2, H29-18-3) that describe mudstone from the collar down, where every neighbouring log shows 10–15 m of soft alluvium first.
source: 国土地盤情報検索サイト「KuniJiban」の地盤情報 (KuniJiban ground information: MLIT, PWRI, PARI). Individual logs carry no copyright.
